subject: Keeping our pilot live while PO completes
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@harborhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot timeline — PO routing slower than expected

Hi Chloe,

Quick update from our side — procurement is taking longer than we anticipated. The PO is drafted but legal and finance are still circling back on contract language and a few billing items. We expect final sign-off in ~7–10 business days, but I wanted to flag that our pilot seats will start to run out in the meantime.

Is there any way to pause the countdown or get a short safety-net while our PO clears? We’re close to a decision and want to avoid losing momentum.

I attached the PO draft for visibility.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Singh
Director of Digital Programs — Harbor Health
[Attachment: Harbor_PO_Draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Finance Team <finance@harborhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline — PO routing slower than expected

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads-up and for sharing the draft.

First, totally understand the procurement lag — we see this often and want to keep the pilot momentum. Two quick options we can offer while you finish approvals:

- Short safety-net voucher: we can apply a one-time 7-day voucher that pauses usage expiry and gives your team a buffer to finish testing.
- Partial credit top-up: apply a small credit (~$500) to cover immediate usage over the next 10 days.

If you prefer the voucher, I can approve it now and Marcus (cc’d) will finalize on the billing side. If you go the PO route we’ll note the PO number against the account once it arrives.

Also, if there are any contract redlines blocking legal, happy to set a 20–30 minute call with our legal ops to speed it up.

Let me know which option you prefer and the expected PO ETA.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: approval needed for 7-day safety-net voucher — Harbor Health (HV-3221)

Marcus —

Maya from Harbor Health asked for a short safety-net while their PO and legal finish routing. They expect sign-off in 7–10 business days. I proposed a 7-day voucher that pauses the pilot timer; customer prefers the voucher rather than a credit.

Details:
- Account: Harbor Health (HV-3221)
- Estimated short-term usage: low (development team running evaluation queries)
- Requested: 7-day voucher to prevent pilot expiry
- PO draft attached to customer email (I can forward if needed)

Can you confirm we can apply the voucher and create the billing note linking it to the upcoming PO? If it helps, apply as a non-refundable account-level voucher for tracking against the deal.

If we need Finance/RevOps sign-off, I can loop them in — just say the word.

Thanks — Chloe

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@harborhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline — PO routing slower than expected

Chloe / Maya —

Thanks for the context. I’ve approved a 7-day safety-net voucher and applied it to Harbor Health’s pilot. You should see the timer paused and the account marked with a voucher note.

Operational notes:
- Voucher code: HV-HOLD-7D (applied account-level)
- Accounting note: link to PO draft on the deal record and mark as "voucher applied pending PO"
- If Harbor needs an invoice-side bridge, Finance (cc’d) can issue a short-term credit memo tied to the eventual PO number.

Maya — you’re all set on our side. If you want the voucher reflected in a DocuSign acknowledgement (for internal audit), let me know and I’ll send a one-page confirmation.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0129
